nom: Peter Thomas Roth Potent-C Niacinamide Discoloration Treatment

avis.texte: I bought this a month ago and I am so happy that I did. My skin is brighter and smoother. I will definitely purchase again!
I use this consistently for two months, morning and night and saw zero results.

I love this product. Fantastic results. I'm an "early" senior and haven't been doing any skin care for a number of years, just took a break. Older skin in a magnifying mirror gets that textured look and the pores versus when in our 20's the skin has that smooth perfect glass surface look. This product did more than any other products to eliminate that texture and pores and it produces that glassy look. It also smoothed little bumps under the eyes. That's just from one over night treatment. Did not expect the "glassy" surface skin results like this. Bought a bunch of product, as I used PTR in the past and loved the Potent C line, but never tried this product. Of course, for lifting or wrinkles something else is required; but, for older women with the "textured" skin and the usual pores, this product is absolutely amazing! Love it !

Im not sure why thisbproduct is rated low. This is oacked with some powerful ingredients, Kojic acid, niacinamide , tranazemic acid, and more. I will continue go repurchase. This was able to lift up the stubborn hyperpigmentation ive been working on all year.

avis.titre: This has made a world of difference on my darkspot
avis.texte: I had a friend ask what I use. This is it and only this. Morning and night. This cream is light weight and I do not feel like I have cream on my face. This is my new go to moisturizer.
I have been using this for over 6 months and I have seen no improvement at all in my dark spots.

avis.titre: Great on skin, doesnt caused redness
avis.texte: Ive had a mark and pigmentation on my face for sometime and been using this product I can already tell the change with only around 5 uses. I highly recommend it.
This is the easiest way to get rid of dark spots, sun or other. I could not be happier with this product. It starting working almost immediately. Look forward to seeing how much better it will get.

I'm so glad Peter combined his Vitamin C with Niacinamide. I've been doing the same by using equal amounts of his Potent Potent - C with his original ProStrength, which is costly to buy them both. This new formulation saves money. Peter's products are the BEST!

This is a poor replacement for the old peter thomas roth pro strength niacinamide discoloration treatment. Now including skin sensitinzing alcohol and titanium dioxide that can cause nanoparticles to accumolate in the body.

Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. This cream works so good for my hyperpigmentation and dark spots. I like how this cream makes my skin look brighter and gives an instant glow on applying. Overall, great product, I would repurchase.

I was gifted complimentary from Peter thomas roth and skeepers in exchange for my honest review and can't say enough about this. Firstly appeared slightly too dark for me but surprisingly it blended in perfectly and added the perfect glow and didn't crease nor peel/seperate. Great alone or with makeup. Highly recommend

I was gifted this product by Peter Thomas Roth for my honest review . As someone that suffers from severe hyper pigmentation, I have yet to find a product that helped. The Potent-C Niacinamide Discoloration Treatment did not disappoint! I have sensitive acne prone skin and once my acne is gone, I'm left with awful dark spots. Since I started using the product, my skin tone has improved significantly! I used this product night and day and haven't had any side effects. I highly recommend this product!

The potent-c niacinamide discoloration treatment was gifted by peterthomasroth in exchange for my honest review. This product definitely has a lot of great ingredients included that should provide a lot of different benefits. I haven't been using the product long enough to see significant long term benefits but in the short term it definitely has a nice brightening effect!

You just can't go wrong with PTR OR Niacinamide! My skin seriously loves this ingredient. It makes me skin look and feel so healthy and I'm always looking to try new products with this ingredient. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

This was offered by peterthomasroth. This has help so much with helping to minimize those freckles and discoloration marks that you get from the sun. It also contains anti-aging properties so it also helps with those fine lines. It's like a vitamin C boost to your face. I use mine morning and night after cleansing my skin before putting on my moisturizer.

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth for reviewing purposes. This amazing Product is like magic in a bottle. For a long time I have looked for a product that helps me clear dark spots and also acne scars and this has help me so much. I now know I desperately needed this. I will purchase another one to have as a backup.

Love this "treatment" although i use it more as a moisturizer. I was gifted this by peterthomasroth only 2 weeks ago so it's still a trial in progress BUT so far, i can confidently say it is working. This is great on its own or mixed into a routine.

Gifted by peterthomasroth and on my first use I really love the texture of product. I used it at night in my skincare routine and over time I'll continue to use it to see results. I can't say truthfully that I've seen results because I've only used the product once but hopefully it provides results over time.

I received this product gifted complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for an honest review. This product has been great! It's not irritating and definitely noticed my dark spots lighten a bit after using

I'm grateful to have been sent this Potent C Niacinamide Treatment complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare in exchange for my review. I haven't been using this long enough yet to see significant changes in my skin yet, but my skin tone already seems more even and brighter. I like the texture and absorption and it isn't too harsh or irritating on my skin.

This cream works wonders on making my skin tone look more even. It is strong enough to be effective and gentle enough to not harm my sensitive skin though I did apply slowly and gradually to my face. It absorbs into my skin quickly. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

avis.titre: Great for post acne dark spots!
avis.texte: This is such a great product for post acne marks, I have always suffered with post acne marks and they take so long to get better. Some days ago I got a huge pimple in my jaw and it leave a dark spot behind, I decided to use this product and try how effective it is and it seems it definetely works for such purpose. Acne spot post inflammation was reduced super fast and the dark spot faded so much faster than usual that I was really amazed by it. My skin also looks brighter and healthier overall. Complimentary from Peterthomasroth, but that does't affect in any way my honest review about the product.

I like this treatment. It makes your face look good. It feels good when you put it on and absorbs quickly so you can finish your makeup routine. I put it on first. If you have a fairly nice complexion this is all you might need. My face looks brighter and skin tone is more even after few applications! My dark spots are gone! Highly recommended. I'm glad to received this product offered by Petter Thomas Roth.

I have some sun spots on my cheeks as well as some minor scarring that I would really like to fade. This was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for an honest review. I'm still building up to daily use with this treatment but so far so good! I have pretty sensitive skin but this serum hasn't led to any redness or reactions. It is fragrance free; it feels gentle and goes on smoothly.

I have quite a few dark spots and old acne marks, so I was excited to try this out. It goes on smoothly and does not cause any unnecessary oiliness or shine. After a few uses, I was noticing that my skin does look brighter and more refreshed in the morning. Gifted by peterthomasroth

Peter Thomas Roth brand has never done me wrong and this is no different. This has truly brightened my skin since I started using it. I also have some minor post acne marks that have softened. My skin looks more youthful and fresh. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

I used this treatment twice a day. It is mild and my skin does not get sensitive. The texture is nice and not greasy at all. After several uses, I can feel my face becoming brighter than before. I would keep using it to see more results. I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

avis.titre: Vit C and Niacinamide in one
avis.texte: I love everything Potent-C line from Peter Thomas Roth and this Niacinamide Discoloration Treatment is not an exception. I have dry, aging, prone to sun damage and spots skin and Vitamin C with Niacinamide in one is the best solution for my kind of skin. It's protects, brightens and makes my pores look smaller. Gifted by PTR

Loved this so much! I have some stubborn dark spots that I've had battles with for months but I never found anything that really made a difference. This however made them lighter within just a week! Super excited to see the results after months of consecutive use. :) gifted by peterthomasroth for review!

I love this product so much! Makes my skin look so even and clear, definitely helps so much with discoloration. I highly recommend this for anyone who is struggling with discoloration and is looking for a product to reduce it. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for my honest feedback.

I have major issues with uneven skin tone and dark pigmentation from sun exposure. This product has the perfect ingredients to deal with that and help even out my skin tone. It leaves me with brighter skin without any irritation. complimentary from peterthomasroth

I've been really enjoying how this serum feels on my skin. I have a ton of acne scars and discoloration so I'm excited to see the results from long-term use. This sinks into my skin so easily and doesn't pill when paired with other products either. complimentary from peterthomasroth

The treatment works very well on my skin, I use it in my morning skincare routine, it feels good on skin while hydrating and brightening the skin tone, makes my skin look radiant and healthy. My overall skin texture really got improved. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

With 15% vitamin C as the active ingredient, I expected it to give me a slight burning sensation. Surprisingly, it doesn't; I think the niacinamide must be helping. Overall, my skin has become brighter and softer. I'll continue using it to see how it helps with my discoloration. It's complimentary from peter thomas roth

This is truly a miracle cream. I used it 3-4 nights on the back of my hands where I have a lot of sun damage and my sunspots are almost gone completely! I'm telling the truth! I need a vat so I can use this on my whole body!! Thank you so much,Peter. I love all your products and have used them for years. Also the acne lotion is a miracle too!!!
